text:
Rae (People Ops): quick check 10-minf planning for a "Spotlight Packs" drop tied to mid-year performance shoutouts. combo: pin + $30 e-gift or manager-selected donation. need deadlines, tax-safe packaging language, and PO logic. thoughts?
Omar (HRBP): manager approvals must happen before any mention in review notes. propose manager cutoff 2 business days before fulfillment.
Pri (Benefits): keep amounts off packaging. e-gift/email should carry the amount + tax FAQ link. donations routed to charity avoid payroll in many countries.
Sam (Finance): use GL-6150 (Recognition). if anyone requests cash instead of e-gift, route through payroll (payroll cutoff: Jun 20 to hit Jun 30 payroll).
Tess (Logistics): prefer regional batches. small physical pin only for US/CAN/UK to avoid customs. others get a digital badge + e-gift. signature only if high value.
Jamie (Intern): quick headcount split I pulled:
```
US/CAN/UK: 320 (pins opt-in est 60%)
EMEA: 210 (digital only)
APAC: 180 (digital only)
Total: 710
```
Rae (People Ops): action items: 1) Jamie: finalize opt-in CSV + flag high-value by Fri. 2) Rae: update nomination form with manager-approval checkbox + auto-reminders (Mon). 3) Sam: draft PO + confirm GL-6150 (Fri). 4) Pri: tax FAQ + e-gift copy (Tue). 5) Tess: vendor lead time + signature rules (Wed).
Omar (HRBP): manager comms should include a sample one-line highlight and a direct approve button.
Tess (Logistics): vendor note: mark physical as "promotional goods" and include HS code 9207 for pins. vendor ok?
Sam (Finance): confirm PO preferred, net-30. I'll start draft.
Rae (People Ops): good. plan to send nomination link next Tue and aim fulfillment week of Jun 28. any objections?
All: :thumbsup:
